biotools.summary: Peptonizer2000 is a tool designed for metaproteomics that uses advanced statistical modeling to improve the precision of taxonomic species identification from microbial communities. It combines proteomic search engine peptide scores with Unipept database links to deliver high-confidence taxonomic assignments.
biotools.name: Peptonizer2000
